definition: At the original 64x256 witness coordinates, rawVisible=(Y>96) OR original raw color mask; splineRelativeVisible=(heldout R>32) OR same original raw color mask; reconciled=AND. For luma-only samples this is Y>max(96, fittedY+32). No threshold changes. The compressed masks are probe-grid masks, not full-resolution source masks.
interpretation: The original raw witness is retained separately and is not replaced by model-only visibility.
The model-only mask can flag low source luma where fitted profile is lower; intersection prevents this model-created foreground.
Intersection count/row gate is a diagnostic result, not a production approval.
